levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن المبارك

notes: «قال حدثني عمي» is a bare relation (Rafi's uncle) and the last link; the Prophet's ruling is the saying
«فقلت لرافع» is a scene question; Rafi' is already a link
«خالفه الأوزاعي» names a differing transmitter but gives no chain in the text, so no variant group is written
